- **Photos rendering:** No. This page also contains only text content (headline and description) with no photo cards or visual assets.

**Image 4 (About)**
- **Photos rendering:** No. This page shows a footer-style navigation menu, a large background text watermark ("DEYOUNG COMMUNICATION"), and a bottom bar. There are no photo cards.

**VERDICT: FAIL**

**Reasoning:** The prompt explicitly required "PHOTO CARDS with real photography" for each of the four pages. All four provided images are text-only layouts (or navigation/footer layouts) that completely lack the requested photographic elements and card components. While the premium dark styling and red accent color are present, the core requirement for photo cards was not met.
